sections.heading: Serena Williams — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Serena Williams was born on 26 September 1981 in Saginaw, and holds American nationality. She was given the name Serena Jameka Williams at birth and is publicly known as Serena Williams.
Public records name her father, Richard A Williams Jr and her mother, Oracene Price. She is a sibling of Venus Williams.
Her listed education includes The Art Institute of Fort Lauderdale, homeschooling and Isenberg School of Management.
She is recorded as speaking French and English.

sections.heading: Serena Williams — Career and Professional Work
paras: Serena Williams works primarily as a tennis player, autobiographer, actor, businessperson, writer and designer, with UNICEF listed among her employers.
On the team sheet, Serena has been associated with United States Billie Jean King Cup team (from 1999) and Washington Kastles.
She has held the following offices: UNICEF Goodwill Ambassador.

She has taken part in tennis at the 2000 Summer Olympics, tennis at the 2008 Summer Olympics, tennis at the 2012 Summer Olympics, tennis at the 2016 Summer Olympics and tennis at the 2012 Summer Olympics – women's singles.
